in_arabic.name: Namar
in_arabic.long_meaning: Namar هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'N-M-R', meaning 'to delight, to please'. This name holds a deep spiritual significance in Islam, symbolizing the joy and happiness that comes from following the path of Allah.
